duplicate_analysis.criterion: maskIoU>0.45 or intersection/min(mask areas)>0.75, the frozen deduplication rule.
duplicate_analysis.interpretation: No strong mask duplicates or reused same-frame IDs does not rule out disjoint fragments of one fruit or historical duplicate track hypotheses.

gap_interpretation: These are gaps in an observed predicted ID only; they do not establish true-object reidentification. The162 adjacent switches exclude gaps by definition.

retention_evidence.hypothesis: Keeping rejected historical tracks for2s may produce persistent competing hypotheses and repeated newborn IDs. Rejection logs omit competitor IDs and scores; causality unproved.

examples.selection: Longest eligible main-plant chain with unchanged class across six changes.
examples.evidence: Six adjacent changes from frame1 through7; all predicted pintona, all old IDs rejected competing_tracks and replaced by newborn IDs.
examples.interpretation: Consistent with accumulated historical track hypotheses competing; competitor identities/scores were not logged, so this is not a proved root cause.
Saved masks can establish divided support and a tile boundary, not prove that either part is a separate fruit without extra private-mask association.

examples.selection: Median sum of previous/current predicted mask area among78 no_box_match-associated changes, deterministic tie breaks.
examples.interpretation: The old ID has no accepted score in the frozen tracker log; no logged flow reliability or candidate scores permits separating flow, appearance, size and silhouette causes.

next_experiment.name: validation_only_competitor_trace_v1
next_experiment.scope: Exactly the same8 validation RGB frames and persisted masks; no detector inference, rendering, training, or test views.
next_experiment.intervention: One instrumented CPU replay of the unchanged frozen tracker, preserving all thresholds and outputs; record candidate track IDs, last_seen age, proposed detection index, scores, flow_reliable and mask overlap before unambiguous_assignment.
next_experiment.controls: Require assignments and rejection reasons identical to existing observations/rejections before interpreting trace; otherwise record divergence and stop.
next_experiment.primary_question: For the32 eligible competing-associated changes, does the same current detection receive proposals from both the immediately previous ID and one or more IDs not observed in the previous frame?
next_experiment.secondary_question: For the sole eligible ambiguous event, do its top-two candidates coincide with the two saved predicted support fragments?
next_experiment.reporting: Report every event and denominator; do not select a threshold or promote a fix. If historical competition is confirmed, predeclare a separate single-variant recent-first association test before running it.

limitations: Eight frames and1.75s cannot establish long-flight performance or3D localization.
Truth IDs appear only in this diagnostic evaluator artifact; never send to inference/tracker.
Rejection totals include repeatedly rejected older IDs; they are not counts of missed fruits.
No root-cause claim for flow or appearance without recorded candidate evidence.
Calyx appearance classes do not establish internal fruit maturity.
